summary_1line: Hanuman secretly observes the sleeping Ravana in a luxurious palace chamber surrounded by his intoxicated, music-bearing wives.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman clings to a palace stairway shadow while Ravana sleeps on a golden couch beneath a white canopy, surrounded by lamps and jeweled ornaments.
The massive Ravana lies like a thundercloud on a jeweled bed, his scarred arms stretched out like serpents as garlanded women sleep around him.
A hall of sleeping demon-king’s wives lies scattered with musical instruments, one woman clutching a vina while another dozes with a drum in her lap.
